create_atari_net_model: create a Net model with 18 actions, 4 input channels, and optional LSTM for Atari RL
build_net_with_lstm: build a Net model with LSTM enabled for temporal processing of Atari game states
run_net_forward_pass: run a forward pass through Net with state, reward, previous action, and done inputs
create_model_from_flags: create a Net model from a flags object with use_lstm and device settings
review_net_initial_state: review the Net initial_state method that returns LSTM hidden and cell state tuples
